purpose: Challenge the selected disclosure-freshness mechanism against all relevant terminal families before freezing its exact formula or reading values.

selected_mechanism.name: quarterly_announcement_freshness_60s
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A more recently effective quarterly disclosure represents fresher firm-specific information and attention, which may persist from the next open through the third close.
selected_mechanism.source_identity: accepted stock-day datetime/symbol/provider identity plus frozen quarterly-quality announcement metadata only

overlap_challenges.reason: The candidate reads no daily price, return, volume, amount, gap, range, trend, reversal, or liquidity field.
The candidate reads no minute row or minute OHLCV/amount field and cannot be changed by holding announcement history fixed while changing the entire intraday path.
The candidate deliberately forbids roe, net_profit, revenue_yoy, profit_yoy, valuation, margin, balance-sheet, and cash-flow values. It measures only when a disclosure first became available.

overlap_challenges.family: sparse corporate events and announcement intensity
overlap_challenges.reason: The candidate is not an event count, amount, sign, surprise, or filing-content factor. It is a deterministic monotone clock since the most recent quarterly disclosure became usable.

The existing gate uses point-in-time quality values and a maximum calendar-day age only to determine eligibility. Campaign020 ranks eligible names continuously by accepted-session age and never reads those quality values.
Candidate49 uses same-session minute close/volume/amount geometry. Campaign020 uses only historical disclosure timing and cannot backfill, modify, or statistically evaluate Candidate49.
Campaign019 uses 240 minute opens/closes and a 120-informative-pair gate. Campaign020 uses no minute body, zero-body rule, pair threshold, or continuity statistic.

counterfactual_independence_tests: Holding instrument, report_date, and announcement_date fixed while changing every historical price, return, range, volume, amount, transaction-price, and market-peer path leaves Campaign020 unchanged.
Holding all terminal factor values fixed while moving the first usable quarterly disclosure session changes Campaign020.
Holding the disclosure session fixed while changing roe, net_profit, revenue_yoy, and profit_yoy leaves Campaign020 unchanged.
prohibited_variants: change the 60-session decay scale after values
use calendar-day age instead of accepted-session age
use report content, surprise, sign, magnitude, quality, valuation, or growth values
use event counts, filing intensity, or selected report types
select years, boards, industries, or subuniverses after values
combine this factor with a terminal factor as a rescue
backfill or compare Candidate49 historical returns
